'''Copeks''' were predators that lived in the core of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

Many [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] families were named after this [[Species/Legends|species]], namely a [[Copek (Gungan)|Gungan Boss]] who lived around [[3000 BBY]].
